config.tipMovieDb: Lapho kuvuliwe, BCookieSubs ingathola imininingwane namaphosta ku-TheMovieDB uma ukhiye we-API usetiwe. Idinga ukubonwa kwegama le-AI ukuthi kusebenze.
config.tipGateBySchedule: Lapho kuvuliwe, ukuhumusha kuphela kugijima ngesikhathi samawindi eshejuli esetiwe.
config.tipLibraryScan: Lapho kuvuliwe, BCookieSubs iskena amafolda emidiya asetiwe ukuze ithole amafayela amasha ezingeniso nemidiya.
config.tipRootLibraryFolder: Ingamisa ifolda eliyisisekelo elisetshenziswa ukunciphisa ukubhrowuza kwendlela yeNgqolobane. Uma lisetwe, ukubhrowuza nezindlela ezintsha zeNgqolobane kuvinjwa kule folda.
config.tipAutoClearLogs: Lapho kuvuliwe, amalogi amadala asuswa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngokwesikhathi sokugcina ngezansi.
config.tipDeleteLogsOlderThan: Amalogi amadala kunalolu lunye lwezinsuku asuswa lapho ukususa ngokuzenzakalelayo kusebenza.
config.tipActiveTheme: Ilawula ithimu yamabala esebenzayo esetshenziswa yisixhosa. Amathimu azikhethela angadaliwa ngezansi.

step1.title: Dala I-akhawunti Yomphathi
step1.subtitle: Lesi yisicelo sokuqala. Dala i-akhawunti yomphathi.

step2.title: Ukusebenza KukaBCookieSubs
step2.subtitle: Ukubuka okusheshayo ngaphambi kokumisa uhlelo.
step2.roleTranslationDesc: Umsebenzi oyisisekelo. Imodeli amukela izigqa zezingeniso ezihlulwe ezishungwini bese ibuyisela umbhalo ohunyushiwe. Okungenani imodeli eyodwa Yokuhumusha iyadingeka. Lapho amamodeli amaningi Okuhumusha esebenza, ngamunye akhiqiza ukuhumusha okulinganiselwe, bese Umahluleli ekhetha okungcono.
step2.roleJudgeDesc: BCookieSubs ikhiqizwa nezinhlobo ezingu-5 zezindlela zokuhumusha ngokujwayelekile. Ishungu ngalinye lihunyushwa kanye njalo endleleni yokukhuthaza esebenzayo, likhiqiza abahlanganyeli abaningi. Umahluleli uhlola bonke abahlanganyeli bese ekhetha ukuhumusha okunembile kakhulu. Ngaphandle kwemodeli yeNmahluleli, umhlanganyeli wokuqala usetshenziswa ngokuqondile.
step2.roleNameFormatterDesc: Ihlukanisa ifilimu noma uhlelo lwe-TV kusukela egameni lefayela noma ifolda. Isetshenziswa lapho kulayishwa izingeniso nangesikhathi sokuskena iNgqolobane ukuze ukuhumusha kukhonjiswe ngomidiya efanele. Idinga ukuxhumana ne-TheMovieDB ukusetwa ngezimiphumela ezingcono.
step2.promptsDesc: Umsebenzi ngamunye usebenzisa isifanekiso sezindlela zokukhuthaza esithunyelwa kwimodeli. Izinguqulo eziningi zezindlela zokukhuthaza zingaba khona. BCookieSubs ilandelela inguqulo esebenza kahle kakhulu kwinkomibineshini ngayinye yemodeli nolimi bese iyinukubeza ngokuzenzakalelayo.
step2.placeholdersLabel: Izithipha zezibambanisi embhalweni wezindlela zokukhuthaza zishintshwa ngesikhathi sokusebenza:
step2.promptsEditHint: Izindlela zokukhuthaza zingahlelwa nokulendelwa ekhasini Lezindlela Zokukhuthaza noma nini.
step2.defaultChunkSizeDesc: Inani lezigqa zezingeniso ezithunyelelwa kwimodeli ngosizo ngalunye. Amashungu amancane anika ingqondo engaphezulu ngokunxenye; amashungu amakhulu ayazisheshisa ngokujwayelekile.
step2.finishOneFirstDesc: Lapho kuvuliwe, wonke amashungu olimi olulodwa aluhlosiwe aqedwa ngaphambi koqala ulimi olulandelayo. Kulungele ukubheka inqubekelaphambili ngesikhathi sangempela.
step2.nameDetectionDesc: Ivumela uHlelo Lwegama ukubona ngokuzenzakalelayo umidiya kusukela emagameni amafayela ngesikhathi sokulayisha nokuskena kweNgqolobane.
step2.tmdbIntegrationDesc: Ixhumeka ku-API ye-TheMovieDB ukuthola amaphosta, izinhlobo, neminyaka yokudedwa kwemidiya ehambisiwe. Idinga ukhiye we-API.
step2.showPostersDesc: Bonisa ubuciko bemidiya ohlwini lwezingeniso nezibukiso zeNgqolobane. Idinga i-TheMovieDB ukusetwa.
step2.libraryScanningDesc: Iskena ngokuzenzakalelayo izindlela zeNgqolobane ezisetwe ukuze ithole amafayela amasha eviyo nezingeniso ngeShejuli, idala amajobhi okuhumusha njengoba kudingeka.
step2.autoClearLogsDesc: Isusa izingdingosi zamalogi amadala kunalo inani lezinsuku elisetwe ukugcina ithebula lamalogi lisebenza kahle.
step2.defaultTargetLangsDesc: Uhlu oluhlelekile lwezilimi izingeniso ezihunyushwa kuzo ngokujwayelekile. Kukhethwa ngaphambi ngabasebenzisi bonke lapho belayisha ifayela lezingeniso noma bakhuthaza ukuhumusha kweNgqolobane.
step2.perUserLangsDesc: Umsebenzisi ngamunye angashintsha izijwayelelo zesistimu ngohlu lwakhe lwezilimi ngezilungiselelo ze-akhawunti yakhe. Abasebenzisi abasha baqala ngezijwayelelo zesistimu. Uzomseta izijwayelelo zesistimu esinyathelweni esilandelayo.

step3.title: Izilimi Zokuhumusha Ezijwayelekile
step3.subtitle: Khetha okungenani ulimi olulodwa okuzohunyushwa izingeniso kulo ngokujwayelekile. Lezi ziba yizijwayelelo zesistimu kubasebenzisi bonke.
step3.empty: Azikho izilimi ezengezwe. Sebenzisa isikhetha ngezansi.

step4.title: Faka Imodeli
step4.subtitle: Faka okungenani imodeli eyodwa. Imisebenzi (Ukuhumusha, Umahluleli, Uhlelo Lwegama) ibekwa esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
step4.rolesHint: Imisebenzi ibekwa esinyathelweni 5. Ungayiseta lapha njengesiqalo.

step5.title: Misela Imisebenzi Yemodeli
step5.subtitle: Beka imisebenzi kumamodeli akho afakiwe. Okungenani imodeli eyodwa kumele ibe nomsebenzi Wokuhumusha ukuze uqhubeke.
step5.configuredEmpty: Awekho amamodeli engezwe. Faka amamodeli ephaneli elingakwesokunxele noma wengeze ngokwezandla ngezansi.
